resumeText:
ROHAN MEHTA
Email: rohan.mehta@example.com | Phone: 0400 000 000
LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/rohanmehta-dev | GitHub: github.com/rohanmehta-dev

SUMMARY
Passionate, hard-working team player with a strong desire to learn and grow. Enthusiastic and dedicated individual who is always eager to take on new challenges and contribute positively to any environment. Quick learner with great communication skills and a genuine love for technology.

SKILLS
Java, Python, JavaScript, SQL, REST APIs, Spring Boot, Flask, PostgreSQL, Docker, Git, Linux, Windows Server, Active Directory, HTML/CSS

EXPERIENCE

IT Support Officer (Part-time, concurrent with studies)
CampusTech Services
03/2022 - Present
Working in the university's IT helpdesk team supporting staff and students across multiple campuses, handling day-to-day technical issues on a part-time basis alongside full-time study.
- Responsible for troubleshooting hardware and software issues for staff and students.
- Responsible for maintaining inventory of IT equipment including laptops, monitors and peripherals.
- Responsible for assisting with user account setups and password resets in Active Directory.
- Attending weekly team meetings and logging all support requests in the helpdesk ticketing system.
- Responsible for setting up classroom and lab computers running Windows Server images before each semester.
- Responsible for escalating unresolved Linux server issues to senior IT staff and documenting the steps taken.
- Responsible for answering phone and email queries from staff regarding network connectivity and printer faults.

Software Developer Intern
BrightLedger Technologies
06/2021 - 01/2022
Six-month internship with a small fintech startup, working within the backend team on an internal reporting and invoicing platform used by the finance department.
- Automated a manual monthly reporting process using Python scripts, reducing data entry time by roughly 70% and saving the finance team approximately 5 hours per week.
- Built and tested REST API endpoints in Java and Spring Boot that were used by over 200 internal staff daily for invoice lookups.
- Fixed 15+ bugs identified during QA cycles, several of which were flagged as blocking issues before a production release.
- Wrote unit tests that increased code coverage on the invoicing module from around 40% to 75%.
- Participated in code reviews with a team of four developers and incorporated feedback into subsequent pull requests.

Retail Assistant
Cornerstone Mart
01/2020 - 01/2021
Part-time retail role held prior to moving to Australia for study, providing early exposure to customer service and teamwork in a fast-paced environment.
- Assisted customers with product enquiries and processed transactions at the point-of-sale register.
- Restocked shelves and maintained store presentation standards during weekend shifts.

PROJECTS

Library Management API
github.com/rohanmehta-dev/library-management-api
- Designed and built a RESTful backend using Java, Spring Boot and PostgreSQL to manage book loans, returns and member records for a mock university library.
- Containerised the application with Docker so it could be deployed consistently across development and testing environments.
- Implemented role-based access control, allowing librarians and members to see different sets of endpoints.
- Wrote integration tests covering the main loan and return workflows.

Task Tracker Web App
github.com/rohanmehta-dev/task-tracker-webapp
- Built a Flask-based web application in Python with a SQL database backend to let small teams create, assign and track tasks.
- Implemented user authentication and session handling from scratch to understand the underlying mechanics before using a library.
- Added a simple REST API layer so the frontend and a command-line client could both interact with the same backend.

Network Monitoring Script
github.com/rohanmehta-dev/network-monitor-script
- Wrote a Python script that runs on Linux to periodically check the status of a list of internal servers and send an alert email if any host becomes unreachable.
- Used cron scheduling on a home Linux server to run the script every five minutes over a two-week test period without manual intervention.

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Information Technology
Southbridge University
02/2022 - 12/2025 (expected)
Majoring in Software Development, with a full course load each semester. Coursework undertaken to date includes:
- Introduction to Programming (Python) - built a command-line calculator and a simple text-based adventure game as semester assignments.
- Object-Oriented Programming (Java) - completed a group assignment building a small inventory management console application.
- Data Structures and Algorithms - implemented linked lists, binary search trees and sorting algorithms from scratch as weekly lab exercises.
- Database Systems - designed a normalised relational schema for a university enrolment system as the major assignment, including ER diagrams and SQL scripts.
- Web Application Development - built a multi-page website with a Flask backend as the capstone project for the semester.
- Operating Systems - studied process scheduling, memory management and file systems, with lab exercises run on a Linux virtual machine.
- Computer Networks - completed assignments on the OSI model, subnetting exercises and a small packet-sniffing lab using Wireshark.
- Software Engineering Practices - worked in a team of five using Agile ceremonies to deliver a semester-long group project, including sprint planning documents and retrospectives.
- Mathematics for Computing - covered discrete mathematics, logic and basic statistics relevant to algorithm analysis.
- Professional Communication for IT - completed presentations and a written report on ethical issues in technology, including a reflective journal submitted weekly.
- Cloud Computing Fundamentals - introductory unit covering virtualisation concepts and a hands-on assignment deploying a sample application to a cloud sandbox environment.
Current GPA: 5.9 / 7.0

Secondary School Certificate
Greenfield Senior Secondary School
02/2016 - 11/2019
Completed senior secondary studies with a focus on Mathematics, Physics and Computer Science. Achieved strong results across all subjects and participated in the school's annual science exhibition in both final years, presenting a working model of a simple automated irrigation system.

CERTIFICATIONS
- Introduction to SQL, completed via an online course, 11/2021.
- Git and Version Control Basics, completed via an online course, 04/2022.

EXTRA-CURRICULAR ACTIVITIES
- Member of the Southbridge University Coding Club, attending weekly meetups since 03/2022 and helping run a beginner-friendly Python workshop for new members in second semester.
- Volunteer note-taker for a peer support program assisting first-year international students with orientation during 2022 and 2023.
- Participated in a 24-hour internal university hackathon in 09/2023, where a four-person team built a basic expense-splitting app; the team did not place but received positive feedback from judges on code structure.

HOBBIES
Enjoys casual badminton on weekends, reading science fiction novels, cooking recipes from different cuisines, and tinkering with small home automation projects using a Raspberry Pi. Also enjoys long walks and following cricket during the international season.

REFERENCES
Ms. Priya Anand
Team Lead, Brightledger Technologies
Email: priya.anand@example.com
Phone: 0400 111 222

Mr. David Collins
IT Services Manager, Campustech Services
Email: david.collins@example.com
Phone: 0400 333 444

Available on request: academic reference from Southbridge University course coordinator.
